hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb can block the line of sight between drivers and pedestrians, particularly children, who might step into the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb on both sides of the street.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: The parked minivan obscures sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk or lawn and drivers on the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, along the curb line

hazards.name: Lack of Designated Crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian warning signs, requiring pedestrians to cross at unmarked locations.
hazards.location_in_image: Visible roadway area

hazards.name: Wide Unmarked Roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings and the width of the asphalt can encourage higher vehicle speeds in a residential area.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image, the main roadway surface.

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Obstruction
hazards.description: A large pickup truck parked at the curb obscures sightlines between the sidewalk and the street for both drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, right side of the street

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Significant cracking and wear on the roadway surface could pose a trip hazard or affect vehicle control.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and foreground of the roadway.

hazards.name: Image Artifact (Blur)
hazards.description: A large blurred area on the right side of the image obscures potential hazards or infrastructure on that side of the street.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is immediately adjacent to the curb with no physical or vertical separation (like trees or a planting strip) from moving or parked traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the entire visible sidewalk edge

hazards.name: Lack of Street Lighting
hazards.description: No street light poles are visible in the immediate vicinity, which may reduce safety and visibility at night.

hazards.name: Lack of crossing infrastructure
hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks or pedestrian warning signs in this residential area may lead to unsafe mid-block crossings.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire roadway surface

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: The left side of the street lacks a formal paved walkway, which may force pedestrians to walk in the roadway or on uneven grass.

hazards.name: Missing Crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection, making pedestrian crossing points ambiguous to drivers.
